display.purpose: Page titles, the name on the Welcome, the 404 number.

numeral.purpose: The year in the margin of every event list; 3rem in the event popup.

story.purpose: An event's text; larger in the popup, smaller in the compact map panel.

body.purpose: Prose on reading pages, descriptions, notes (max 65ch).

label.purpose: Field labels and list sub-headings, sentence case, no tracking.

motion.name: develop
motion.value: 1.4s ease-out both: opacity 0.15 and the border colour, to opacity 1 and the foreground colour
motion.purpose: The one gesture: the Welcome's name and the 404's number develop like a print.

motion.name: grain-settle
motion.purpose: The hourglass grains settling in, on the Welcome only.

motion.name: fade-in
motion.purpose: Supporting elements appearing once, without travel.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover and focus colour changes; nothing moves.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar and map events panel switch from drawers to docked columns.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action of a view: Exposure Blue, 44px, 3px corners.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); font: 500 0.875rem/1 "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(var(--primary) / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--background)), 0 0 0 4px hsl(var(--ring)); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions: print, clear search, suggested countries.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input)); border-radius: 3px; background: hsl(var(--background)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font: 500 0.875rem/1 "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: hsl(var(--accent)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--background)), 0 0 0 4px hsl(var(--ring)); }

components.name: Field
components.description: Square, hairline, 44px; the same focus ring as buttons.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); } .ds-field-input { min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input)); border-radius: 0; background: hsl(var(--background)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--ring)); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Links on the fixed Prussian board; the active one in Fixer Yellow with a left rule.
components.html: MappaArchivioIl mio secolo
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; width: 240px; padding: 8px 0; background: hsl(var(--sidebar)); font: 700 0.875rem/1.25rem "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { padding: 10px 14px; border-left: 2px solid transparent; color: hsl(var(--sidebar-foreground) / 0.7); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s, background-color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: hsl(var(--sidebar-foreground)); background: hsl(var(--sidebar-border) / 0.2); border-left-color: hsl(var(--sidebar-border)); } .ds-nav-item.is-active { color: hsl(var(--sidebar-accent)); border-left-color: hsl(var(--sidebar-accent)); background: hsl(var(--sidebar-border) / 0.4); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--sidebar)), 0 0 0 4px hsl(var(--sidebar-accent)); }

components.name: Map Plaque Toggle
components.description: Controls over the map: a Prussian plate, the active segment filled Fixer Yellow.
components.css: .ds-plaque { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.15); background: rgb(14 42 71 / 0.9); } .ds-plaque-btn { height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8); font: 500 0.875rem/1 "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-plaque-btn:hover { color: #fff; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); } .ds-plaque-btn.is-active { background: hsl(var(--highlight)); color: hsl(var(--highlight-foreground)); } .ds-plaque-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #000, 0 0 0 4px hsl(var(--sidebar-accent)); }

components.name: Event Row
components.description: The unit of every list: the year in a Literata margin, the event beside it.
components.css: .ds-event { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3.75rem minmax(0, 1fr); column-gap: 12px; width: 100%; padding: 12px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); background: none; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-event-year { font: 600 1.25rem/1.5rem Literata, Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-event-text { display: block; font: 400 1rem/1.375 Literata, Georgia, serif; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-event-meta { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font: 400 0.75rem/1rem "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, sans-serif; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); } .ds-event:hover .ds-event-text { color: hsl(var(--primary)); } .ds-event:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--background)), 0 0 0 4px hsl(var(--ring)); }

components.name: Grain Column
components.description: One grain per event, piled per century or decade; the column is a link.
components.css: .ds-grains { display: inline-grid; justify-items: center; gap: 6px; width: 44px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-grain-pile { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap-reverse; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; width: 17px; border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); padding-bottom: 2px; } .ds-grain-pile i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: hsl(var(--primary)); transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-grains:hover .ds-grain-pile i { background: hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-grain-label { font: 600 0.75rem/1 Literata, Georgia, serif; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-grains:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--ring)); }

components.name: Hourglass Wordmark
components.description: 20 grains in rows 4-3-2-1-1-2-3-4 beside the name in Literata.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 600 1.125rem/1 Literata, Georgia, serif; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-wordmark svg { height: 20px; width: auto; fill: currentColor; }

narrative.overview:
Grains of History is printed, not painted. A cyanotype turns paper Prussian blue where light reaches it, and that one chemistry carries the whole system. Text, the sidebar board and the deepest heat are Prussian blue on a cold white paper. The dark theme is the plate's negative, not a "night mode". Historical photographs are toned blue as prints. The one moving gesture is an image developing, paper turning to blue. History arrives in grains: every event is one, in the hourglass mark, in the charts, in the name.

Density follows the reader. Reading surfaces (the guide, the methodology, the legal pages, an event's popup) hold a 65-character column of Literata and Atkinson Hyperlegible, with a contents rail in the margin. Tool surfaces (the map panel, the Archive's filters, Settings) are compact and ruled. The year is the fact that leads every list.

The system rejects the look it replaced, confirmed with the user in the rebrand: no warm cream with a red accent, no all-caps tracked labels, no monospace datelines, no middle-dot meta strings, no boxed card kit. It is quiet everywhere except where a print develops.
keyCharacteristics: One blue family carries everything; fixer yellow is the only warm colour, and only as a fill or a ring on Prussian.
Every text pairing clears 7:1 in both themes.
Literata for what is read (titles, years, events), Atkinson Hyperlegible for what is operated (labels, controls, figures in prose).
Flat: depth comes from tonal surfaces and hairlines, never shadow.
Grains, the round dot, are the system's one recurring form: the mark, the charts.
One authored motion: `develop`. Everything else appears without travel, except what answers the reader's own action: a drawer, the map's camera.

rules.name: The Fixer Rule
rules.body: Fixer yellow is never text on paper and never decoration. It is a fill under Prussian text, or a ring or rule on a Prussian surface. It marks exactly one thing: what is selected or focused there.

rules.name: The Seven-to-One Rule
rules.body: Every text pairing holds at least 7:1 in both themes. Check a new pairing by computed contrast, not by eye. The tokens above already carry their measured ratios in `globals.css`.

rules.name: The Paper Map Rule
rules.body: The map is printed on the paper: land and sea are both Paper, countries are Country Line hairlines, and only today's countries are exposed, so nothing else on the map may be blue (blue water would read as "1–2 events"). Place names appear only from zoom 4, in Shade on a paper halo, in the interface's language, and never in italic.

rules.name: The Year Leads Rule
rules.body: In any list of events the year is the first thing read: Literata numerals in a fixed margin column, the text beside it. A list whose rows share one day does not repeat the day.

rules.name: The Real Weights Rule
rules.body: Only self-hosted real weights exist: Literata 400 and 600, Atkinson 400 and 700. Nothing is bold beyond them, and nothing is italic: no italic is loaded, and a synthesized slant is banned.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No all-caps labels and no added letter-spacing. Monospace only for code, storage keys and keyboard keys.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: A surface is separated by tone or by a rule, never by a shadow. Nothing lifts on hover: state shows as colour.

rules.name: The Grain Rule
rules.body: A dot means one item, an event, a grain of history. Do not use dots as bullets, status lights or decoration.

dos: **Do** set every text pairing at 7:1 or more in both themes, and verify it by computed contrast.
**Do** lead event lists with the year in Literata numerals (`YearMark`).
**Do** use Fixer Yellow only for what is selected or focused on a Prussian surface, as a fill under Prussian text or as a ring.
**Do** separate sections with a hairline rule above them, not a box around them.
**Do** keep 44px touch targets and a visible focus ring on every interactive element.
**Do** tone atmospheric photographs as cyanotypes, and keep evidence images in true colour.
**Do** write errors and empty states as direction: what happened, and what to do next.
donts: **Don't** add a box-shadow, blur, glass or gradient anywhere.
**Don't** use all-caps labels, tracked letter-spacing, middle-dot meta strings, monospace data labels, or a "→" appended to a link.
**Don't** apply italic or a weight that is not self-hosted (Literata 400/600, Atkinson 400/700).
**Don't** put Fixer Yellow text on paper, or a Prussian focus ring on a Prussian surface.
**Don't** use dots for anything but grains.
**Don't** add a second motion vocabulary: no slide-up entrances, no hover lifts.
